description: This file defines the UsersController class which handles user-related HTTP requests such as creating a new user and login within an ASP.NET Core application. It utilizes MediatR for command handling.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: Controller for user-related endpoints including user creation and login.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles user creation via POST request to /users, sending a Create.Command through MediatR.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles user login via POST request to /users/login, sending a Login.Command through MediatR.
